author: Melody Rivera
title: Fox interrupted for breaking news as Trump gives clear sign Putin relationship is unravelling - NewsBreak
text:
By Melody Rivera ,
8 hours ago Fox News interrupted its regular programming with a breaking news update about the current state of affairs between Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin .
During the Wednesday, Sept. 3 airing of The Faulkner Focus, host Harris Faulkner handed over the reins to Senior White House correspondent Jacqui Heinrich, who provided insight into the latest warning from the U.S. president aimed at his Russian counterpart. She began by saying, "Yesterday, the president expressed his deep disappointment in Putin's actions and also mentioned 'will be doing something to help people live.'"
He once again warned of consequences if Putin does not meet with Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

READ MORE: Fox News cut off for breaking news as Trump gives update on crime crackdown
At a press conference, Trump revealed, "I have learned things that will be very interesting. I think in the next few days you will find out."
One journalist had asked, "Will there be any consequences if there isn't some type of announcement of a meeting with President Putin and President Zelenskyy?"
Trump confidently responded, "Yeah. Yeah there will be,".
Heinrich also relayed Putin's reaction to Trump's cautionary words.
While attending a military parade in China , Putin spoke to a gathering of journalists, stating, "We observe the stance of the current U.S. administration under Trump's leadership.
"We see not just their statement, but a genuine desire to find a solution," he continued. "It seems to me there is a certain light at the end of the tunnel. We shall see how the situation develops.
"If not, we will have to achieve all of the goals set before us through military means," Putin concluded.
The Russian president's appearance at the military parade marks another step towards the unraveling of his previous relationship with Trump.
Trump viewed Putin's reunion with North Korean Leader Kim Jong Un and Chinese President Xi Jinping as a scheme against him.
On Truth Social, the U.S. president posted, "Please give my warmest regards to Vladimir Putin, and Kim Jong Un, as you conspire against The United States of America."
While the gathering may have created an even wider rift between Trump and Putin, it has bolstered the partnership between North Korea and Russia.
Following the parade, President Putin and leader Kim Jong Un held private discussions.
The North Korean leader indicated the two nations' bond is significantly more robust than it was a year ago.
Trump and Putin's rapport has consistently declined as the Russian president continues to dismiss the ceasefire agreement negotiated by the U.S. president.
While Putin collaborates with Kim Jong Un, President Trump is preparing to welcome the President of Poland Karol Nawrocki, in an attempt to address NATO and the conflict in Ukraine.
